title: Push to talk
description: A momentary recording control captures a local voice note and hands off to playback on release.
useCase: Leave a short voice message without a persistent recording mode.
interaction: Enable the microphone, hold to record, release to finish, then play the take.
reducedMotion: Recording feedback changes state without color tweening. Actual capture and playback remain opt-in.
limitations: Requires microphone permission and MediaRecorder support. Takes are capped at 30 seconds, stored only in memory and discarded on unmount.
look: Near-black green-tinted page with a large thin-weight seconds counter, a glowing lime dot and a wide lime rounded button with a microphone icon.
motion: Holding the button records: it turns dark olive to lime in 140 ms, a dot glows and a counter ticks toward 30 s; releasing saves a playable take.
adapt: Recording runs through `start` and `stop` in the `hold` button's pointer and key handlers using `MediaRecorder`; visuals are `.hold[data-recording=true]` (140 ms transition) and the `light` dot. Tune the 30 s cap in the `setInterval` effect; upload the `Blob` built in `onstop`.
